transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to hold a batch-disposition huddle for Batch H-418 before any release decision. As you know, a cure-temperature alarm appeared during the Tuesday night run on Press 8, even though the electronic production record shows the programmed temperature was within spec for the batch. We've got 1,000 molded housings staged on pallets P1 through P4, and nothing has shipped yet. Before I make my disposition decision, I need two things: a verbal laboratory report on the housings and a pallet-level traceability check on P1 through P4. Can someone from the lab and someone from traceability walk me through what we're looking at?

transcript.text: Elena, here's my verbal laboratory report on Batch H-418. I completed a differential-scanning-calorimetry review of retained samples after the cure-temperature alarm. The DSC review confirmed that exactly 240 of the 1,000 housings from Batch H-418 are undercured. These 240 housings require a 4-hour thermal rework, and all 240 reworked housings will require a hardness test before release. The lab report is still awaiting my final upload to the quality system.
